categories.main_business_segments: FSP Technology Inc. primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of power supply units, including PC power supplies, adapters, open frame power supplies, industrial power supplies, medical power supplies, chargers, and energy storage systems. The company also provides related import-export and distribution services. Its product portfolio serves various applications such as personal computers, industrial computers, networking, medical devices, and electric vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced power supply design and manufacturing technologies, including modular and integrated circuit designs, high-efficiency 80 PLUS certifications (Platinum, Titanium, Gold), and compliance with international safety standards (UL, TUV, CE). It operates in-house testing labs for electromagnetic interference, noise, and safety certifications, and employs digital design tools like PLM and 3D layout systems to accelerate product development. Production includes automated assembly lines and quality control processes such as ICT testing and burn-in tests.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FSP serves a diverse customer base including PC manufacturers, industrial computer makers, networking equipment producers, medical device companies, and electric vehicle manufacturers. Its products are used in desktops, notebooks, servers, edge computing devices, POS systems, and industrial applications. The company targets both branded and white-label clients globally, with a focus on markets driven by AI, 5G, and IoT growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, China, and Vietnam, and sales offices or warehouses in Europe, the Americas, and Asia including Germany, the UK, France, the US, Russia, China, Japan, Korea, India, Brazil, and Finland. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, with significant revenue from Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: FSP Technology Inc. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of power supply units. It sources components from upstream suppliers such as semiconductor and passive component manufacturers and supplies finished power products downstream to OEMs and system integrators in various electronic industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-power, high-efficiency power supplies tailored for AI, edge computing, networking, and industrial applications. R&D focuses on developing products compliant with emerging standards like USB PD 3.1, ATX 3.1, and CRPS platforms, enhancing power density and efficiency (Titanium and Platinum levels), and expanding into energy storage and electric vehicle charging solutions. It also invests in digital design tools and sustainability initiatives aligned with ESG goals.
categories.revenue_model: FSP generates revenue primarily through the sale of power supply products and related components. It operates on a B2B model supplying OEMs and system integrators worldwide. The company also engages in licensing and distribution activities but mainly relies on product sales for income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a mature and highly competitive global power supply market, particularly strong in PC and industrial power supplies. It positions itself as a leading Taiwanese manufacturer with a broad product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities. Competitors include other global power supply manufacturers focusing on efficiency, reliability, and compliance with international standards. FSP leverages its comprehensive product lines and close collaboration with major chipset makers like Intel and AMD to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported fiscal year, FSP recorded consolidated revenues of approximately NT$11.6 billion, representing an 11.98% decline from the previous year, with net profit after tax of NT$438 million, down 31.53%. The company sold about 16.5 million units in the year. Despite recent revenue declines due to market conditions, it plans to grow sales to 18 million units in the next year, driven by AI and edge computing demand. R&D expenses accounted for over 5% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FSP emphasizes delivering innovative, high-quality, and energy-efficient power supply solutions that meet stringent international standards and evolving customer needs in AI, edge computing, and industrial sectors. Its competitive differentiation lies in a comprehensive product portfolio covering a wide power range, rapid product development cycles enabled by advanced R&D and testing facilities, and strong global logistics and customer support. The company also focuses on sustainability and ESG compliance, enhancing its appeal to environmentally conscious customers.
